newsitem.title: KENYA: Emirates to start twice weekly flights to Tanzania.
newsitem.headline: Emirates to start twice weekly flights to Tanzania.

text.p: Emirates, the international carrier of the United Arab Emirates, will launch twice weekly flights to the Tanzanian capital of Dar es Salaam in October, the airline announced in Nairobi on Monday.
The airline said that it would fly Airbus A310-300 aircraft once a week non-stop Dubai-Dar es Salaam and Dar es Salaam-Dubai, and once a week via the Kenyan capital of Nairobi.
The first flight on the new route will be on October 28.
Emirates already flies to Dubai from Nairobi four times a week. The flight from Tanzania will provide a fifth Emirates flight from the Nairobi sector.
